upserted_store_skills.name: Reward Function Contract Definition
upserted_store_skills.description: Check whether a submitted task was successfully cancelled or has finished running without blocking. Returns True only if the task is no longer pending.

upserted_store_skills.name: Executor Submit and Future Retrieval
upserted_store_skills.description: Schedule a callable for asynchronous execution using an Executor's submit() method and retrieve the result via Future.result(). Use when you need to run a single task in parallel without blocking the main thread.

upserted_store_skills.name: Executor Map for Concurrent Iteration
upserted_store_skills.description: Apply a function to multiple iterables concurrently using Executor.map(), with optional timeout and chunksize control. Returns results in order, with timeout and exception handling.

upserted_store_skills.name: Executor Shutdown and Resource Cleanup
upserted_store_skills.description: Signal an Executor to free resources after pending futures complete, with optional cancellation of unstarted futures. Use when you are done submitting tasks and want to ensure clean resource release.

upserted_store_skills.name: Select Executor Type for Parallel Workload
upserted_store_skills.description: Canonical skill for choosing between ThreadPoolExecutor (I/O-bound tasks) and ProcessPoolExecutor (CPU-bound tasks) based on workload characteristics. Both implement the same Executor interface but differ in concurrency model, resource overhead, and GIL interaction.

upserted_store_skills.name: ThreadPoolExecutor Context Manager Setup
upserted_store_skills.description: Use ThreadPoolExecutor with a `with` statement to automatically manage executor lifecycle and ensure all submitted tasks complete before context exit.

upserted_store_skills.name: ThreadPoolExecutor Deadlock Avoidance
upserted_store_skills.description: Detect and prevent circular wait conditions where futures block on other futures' results within the same ThreadPoolExecutor. Identifies scenarios where a limited number of worker threads can become exhausted if a submitted task calls .result() on another future in the same pool.

upserted_store_skills.name: ThreadPoolExecutor Worker Count Configuration
upserted_store_skills.description: Set the max_workers parameter when initializing ThreadPoolExecutor to match workload concurrency needs, balancing task throughput against system resource constraints and I/O characteristics.

upserted_store_skills.name: ThreadPoolExecutor Worker Initialization
upserted_store_skills.description: Configure per-worker thread initialization using the initializer and initargs parameters to set up shared resources (database connections, logging context, file handles) once at thread startup. Reduces per-task overhead by amortizing expensive resource setup across multiple tasks executed by the same worker thread.

upserted_store_skills.name: ThreadPoolExecutor Configuration and Worker Reuse
upserted_store_skills.description: Configure ThreadPoolExecutor with adaptive max_workers sizing (min(32, os.cpu_count() + 4)) and enable idle worker thread reuse to balance I/O-bound and CPU-bound task execution while avoiding excessive resource allocation on multi-core systems.

upserted_store_skills.name: ProcessPoolExecutor Initialization with Worker Setup
upserted_store_skills.description: Initialize a ProcessPoolExecutor with an optional initializer callable and initargs to configure per-worker process state. Handle BrokenProcessPool exceptions when initializer fails on any worker.

upserted_store_skills.name: URL Fetch with Timeout
upserted_store_skills.description: Execute a single URL fetch operation with configurable timeout protection, returning response content as bytes. Designed for concurrent execution via ThreadPoolExecutor in I/O-bound workloads.

upserted_store_skills.name: ProcessPoolExecutor Deadlock Prevention Rule
upserted_store_skills.description: Enforce constraint that Executor or Future methods must not be called from within callables submitted to ProcessPoolExecutor to prevent deadlock.

upserted_store_skills.name: Validate ProcessPoolExecutor Module Importability
upserted_store_skills.description: Enforce that code using ProcessPoolExecutor is structured as an importable module or script, not executed in an interactive interpreter. Worker subprocesses must be able to import the __main__ module for ProcessPoolExecutor to function correctly.

upserted_store_skills.name: Future State Polling and Cancellation
upserted_store_skills.description: Query and manage the lifecycle state of asynchronous task execution using Future methods. Inspect whether a task is running, completed, or cancelled, and attempt early cancellation before execution begins.

upserted_store_skills.name: ProcessPoolExecutor Worker Lifecycle Configuration
upserted_store_skills.description: Configure worker process creation and lifecycle parameters to control process start method, initialization, and worker reuse in ProcessPoolExecutor. Use when customizing process pool behavior for specific OS constraints, initializing worker state, or managing worker task limits.

upserted_store_skills.name: BrokenProcessPool Exception Handling
upserted_store_skills.description: Detect and handle BrokenProcessPool exception raised when a worker process in ProcessPoolExecutor terminates abruptly. Prevents undefined behavior such as freezing or deadlock by catching the exception, logging the failure, and ensuring graceful cleanup before escalating to caller.

upserted_store_skills.name: Future Result Retrieval with Timeout
upserted_store_skills.description: Retrieve the result of an asynchronous task execution with optional timeout handling. Blocks until the result is available or the timeout expires, raising TimeoutError if the result is not available within the specified timeout window.

upserted_store_skills.name: Future Exception Inspection with Timeout
upserted_store_skills.description: Inspect the exception raised by an asynchronous task without blocking indefinitely. Returns None if the task completed successfully, or raises TimeoutError if the exception is not available within the timeout window.

upserted_store_skills.name: Future Completion Callback Registration
upserted_store_skills.description: Attach a callback function to be invoked when a future completes or is cancelled. Callbacks are executed in the order added and always run in the thread that registered them. Enables non-blocking notification and post-processing when an asynchronous task finishes.

upserted_store_skills.name: Future State Transition Control
upserted_store_skills.description: Atomically finalize a Future object's state by setting its result or exception exactly once. Enforces state immutability and prevents double-transition. Use when an Executor implementation or test harness needs to mark a parallel task as complete.

upserted_store_skills.name: Parallel Task Completion Polling
upserted_store_skills.description: Wait for one or more Futures to complete with configurable timeout and return condition. Supports three completion modes: return when any task finishes (FIRST_COMPLETED), return when any task raises an exception (FIRST_EXCEPTION), or return when all tasks finish (ALL_COMPLETED). Use to synchronize on parallel task outcomes and partition results into done and pending sets.

upserted_store_skills.name: Concurrent Futures Exception Classification and Recovery
upserted_store_skills.description: Classify exceptions raised by concurrent.futures operations (CancelledError, TimeoutError, BrokenExecutor, InvalidStateError) and route to appropriate recovery handlers (retry, fallback, escalate, or abort) to implement robust error recovery in parallel task workflows.

upserted_store_skills.name: GRPO Reward Scaling and Advantage Computation
upserted_store_skills.description: Compute scaled advantages for each completion by normalizing rewards using standard deviation, with optional disable flag to prevent question-level difficulty bias. This skill normalizes reward signals across a group of G completions per prompt to ensure fair advantage estimates.
